title: Secure Management Network Design
summary: Design, implement, and verify enterprise management plane security using dedicated management VLAN segmentation, cryptographic SSHv2 access, and VTY access-class filtering on Cisco IOS routers and switches. Isolate infrastructure management interfaces from user data subnets and enforce strict administrative access controls.
learning_objectives: Architect a dedicated out-of-band management network design separating management and user data planes
Configure isolated Switched Virtual Interfaces on dedicated Management VLAN 99 with default gateway reachability
Enforce cryptographic SSHv2 device management and disable plaintext Telnet on all VTY lines
Implement standard and extended access control lists restricting administrative access to authorized workstations
Diagnose and remediate management plane vulnerabilities including default VLAN 1 exposure and missing VTY filters

source.origin: Independently authored enterprise management plane hardening guide based on NIST SP 800-123 and Cisco IOS security baselines
